<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Fixing page indicator parsing**
</details></think>

_**Agent (gpt-5.3-codex 2026-03-01 15:14:50Z)**_

I found the root cause in the UI hierarchy dump: for Japanese, the indicator value is `全5ページ中の1ページ目`, so the digits are extracted as `5, 1` (total first, current second). The test assumed `current, total`, so it never recognizes page 2. I’m patching the parser to detect and normalize this order.

_**Agent (gpt-5.3-codex 2026-03-01 15:14:52Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="apply_patch"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **apply_patch**</summary>
**Update: `/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataruScreenshotUITests/FeatureScreenshotScenariosUITests.swift`**

```diff
@@
         for text in rawTexts {
             let numbers = extractPageNumbers(from: text)
             if numbers.count >= 2 {
-                return (numbers[0], numbers[1])
+                let first = numbers[0]
+                let second = numbers[1]
+                if first > second {
+                    return (second, first)
+                }
+                return (first, second)
             }
         }
```
</details></tool-use>

_**Agent (gpt-5.3-codex 2026-03-01 15:18:45Z)**_

Root cause was in pager-state parsing for Japanese.  
On iOS `ja`, the page indicator value is like `全5ページ中の1ページ目` (total first, current second), but the test assumed `current, total`, so `test_07_onboarding_pager` never detected page 2.

Updated [FeatureScreenshotScenariosUITests.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataruScreenshotUITests/FeatureScreenshotScenariosUITests.swift) to fix this and make pager advancement more robust:

- `test_07_onboarding_pager` now uses retrying `advanceOnboardingPager(to:timeout:)` for each target page ([line 75](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataruScreenshotUITests/FeatureScreenshotScenariosUITests.swift:75)).
- Added `onboardingPagerElement(...)` + fallback swiping logic in `advanceOnboardingPagerOneStep()` ([line 193](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataruScreenshotUITests/FeatureScreenshotScenariosUITests.swift:193)).
- `parsePageState(...)` now:
  - extracts Unicode digits safely,
  - parses from value/label/identifier,
  - normalizes digit order when needed (`first > second` => treat as `total,current`) ([line 284](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataruScreenshotUITests/FeatureScreenshotScenariosUITests.swift:284)).
